summary_en: Year-end dividend raised 15 yen/share from ¥60 to ¥75 for FY7/26 (Aug 2025–Jul 2026). Revision driven by upward earnings forecast: operating profit ¥2,631M (+7.0%), net income ¥1,919M (+11.6%), marking seventh consecutive record in net income.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: On 12 June 2026, Samco Inc. announced an upward revision to its full-year earnings forecast and dividend policy for the fiscal year ending 31 July 2026 (1 August 2025 – 31 July 2026). Driven by stronger-than-expected performance, the company raised operating profit guidance from ¥2,460M to ¥2,631M (+7.0%), net income from ¥1,720M to ¥1,919M (+11.6%), and earnings per share from ¥214.38 to ¥238.91. The company increased its year-end (period-end) dividend by 15 yen per share from ¥60 to ¥75. This marks the seventh consecutive year of record net income. Management noted that revenue is tracking toward a fifth consecutive all-time high, supported by disciplined pricing and improved operational efficiency. The dividend increase reflects the company's policy of combining stable baseline distributions with performance-linked supplements, while maintaining investment in R&D and capital equipment.
